result.reason: The transition-assistance obligation reaches the preferred six-month period at then-current rates, but the data-return deadline runs from Customer’s request rather than expiry or termination, allowing the required export to occur later than 30 days after exit. Deletion certification is also only required upon request, whereas the preferred position requires certification after deletion. The additions are otherwise targeted and generally preserve the original commercial intent, though the numbering and punctuation should be cleaned up.
